  AND toLower(replace(replace(replace(trim(toString(resolution.resolutionScope)), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '')) IN ['document', 'wholedocument', 'tdoc', 'wholetdoc']
  AND toLower(replace(replace(replace(trim(toString(meeting.workingGroup)), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '')) = 'ran3'
MATCH (packed)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK|HAS_CR]-(pack:CRPack)
WHERE (packed:Tdoc OR packed:CR)
  AND packed.tdocNumber = document.tdocNumber
  AND pack.crPackId STARTS WITH 'RP-'
  AND pack.crPackId = 'RP-220218'
RETURN DISTINCT document.tdocNumber AS document, decision.dispositionCode AS disposition, meeting.meetingNumber AS wg_meeting
